panels.title: Succeeded
panels.description: Each accepted attempt is one sample on quorum_attempts_total. This counts those samples over the last hour.

panels.title: Refused
panels.description: Each accepted attempt is one sample on quorum_attempts_total. This counts those samples over the last hour.

panels.title: Activity
panels.description: Empty reference, outcome, group id, and session id fields keep every row. Refused does not include succeeded. Loki stores quorum.group_id and quorum.session_id as quorum_group_id and quorum_session_id. The dashboard time picker is the time range.

targets.expr: {service_name="quorum"} | label_format reference_match=`{{ if eq "${reference}" "" }}1{{ else }}{{ if eq .quorum_reference "${reference}" }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}{{ end }}`, outcome_match=`{{ if eq "${outcome}" "" }}1{{ else }}{{ if eq .quorum_outcome "${outcome}" }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}{{ end }}`, group_match=`{{ if eq "${group_id}" "" }}1{{ else }}{{ if eq .quorum_group_id "${group_id}" }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}{{ end }}`, session_match=`{{ if eq "${session_id}" "" }}1{{ else }}{{ if eq .quorum_session_id "${session_id}" }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}{{ end }}` | reference_match="1" | outcome_match="1" | group_match="1" | session_match="1"
